description: This file implements functions related to logging file descriptors, including initialization and cleanup, for the lighttpd server.

methods.name: fdlog_st * fdlog_init(const char * const fn,const int fd,const int mode)
methods.description: Initializes a new fdlog_st structure with the provided filename, file descriptor, and mode.

methods.name: void fdlog_free(fdlog_st * const fdlog)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the fdlog_st structure and closes the file descriptor if applicable.

ctags.pattern: /^fdlog_init (const char * const fn, const int fd, const int mode)$/
ctags.signature: (const char * const fn,const int fd,const int mode)
